Class PlayerColorRegistry

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.view.GUI.registry.PlayerColorRegistry
public class PlayerColorRegistry extends Object
Singleton registry that assigns a JavaFX color to each player.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static PlayerColorRegistry getInstance()
      Returns the singleton instance of the registry.
      Returns:
      the shared PlayerColorRegistry instance

    • init

      public void init(List<String> nicknames)
      Assigns a color from the built-in palette to each player nickname, in the order the nicknames appear in the list. Any previous assignments are cleared before the new ones are applied. Call this once in GUIHandler.switchToGame() using the player nicknames.
      Parameters:
      nicknames - the ordered list of player nicknames to assign colors to

    • getColor

      public javafx.scene.paint.Color getColor(String nickname)
      Returns the JavaFX color for the given nickname. If the nickname is not registered, returns gray as a fallback.

    • getHex

      public String getHex(String nickname)
      Returns the CSS hex color string assigned to the given player, suitable for use in JavaFX inline styles.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      Returns:
      the assigned hex color (e.g. "#e05740"), or "#888888" if the nickname is not registered
